title: Jeju in December to February: What to Pack and Do
summary: Jeju is milder than Seoul in winter, but coastal winds can make it feel much colder. Learn what to wear and how to enjoy tangerines, camellias, and snowy Hallasan.

slides.title: December–February: Pack Layers
slides.voice: Jeju from December to February gets windy. Pack layers.

slides.title: Three Layers For Wind
slides.sub: Base layer, warm mid-layer, windproof jacket
slides.voice: Base layer, warm mid-layer, windproof jacket. Coastal highs are about nine to thirteen degrees, but wind feels colder.
slides.photo_query: winter base layer mid-layer windproof jacket

slides.title: Pick Winter Tangerines
slides.voice: Winter is tangerine season. Search “귤따기” in Naver or KakaoMap for picking farms.

slides.title: Find Winter Blooms
slides.sub: Check garden hours before you go
slides.voice: Camellias bloom through winter. Check garden hours before you go.

slides.title: Get Ready For Snow
slides.voice: For snowy Hallasan, bring crampons; check trail status that morning.
